name: China Kepei Education Group Limited
summary: China Kepei Education Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides private vocational education services focusing on profession-oriented and vocational education in the People's Republic of China. It operates degree-granting undergraduate-level education institutions, including Guangdong Polytechnic College, Harbin Institute of Petroleum, and Huaibei Polytechnic College. The company also operates Zhaoqing Science and Technology Secondary Vocational School that provides secondary vocational education services.
